pro_course_detail.title: English from Stories and News
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class, our practice revolves around reading for fun, enhanced by AI tools to make the experience more engaging. Reading things you’re interested in exercises all four core language skills (reading, listening, speaking, and writing). Many never become fluent enough to comfortably read in another language or were never given the option to read what they wanted in class. Teachers often move on to other activities, neglecting the benefits of sustained reading. Here, we correct that!

Pleasure reading has an impressive track record. Each hour of guided, self-selected reading in English improves TOEIC scores more than two hours in a TOEIC classroom! Imagine acquiring English through enjoyable stories and news while other students struggle with less effective lessons.

We have a variety of short stories, graded readers, and simplified news sites to choose from. You won’t read alone—I’ll be with you, using AI tools to break down texts, review, and preview lessons. My goal is to engage you with input slightly above your current understanding, fill gaps, and keep you excited to read more complex material. After getting hooked, your fluency will take off like a rocket!

pro_course_detail.title: Accent Reduction & Pronunciation
pro_course_detail.description:
This is my signature class. If you want to reduce your accent and speak more like a native English speaker, this is the class for you!

CLASS OVERVIEW
We will work on a feature of native English pronunciation such as: sounds, word stress and rhythm, intonation, or connected speech

You will have a Google Doc with custom-made lessons tailored to your native language and you. I have designed study plans for speakers of major language families such as Russian, Chinese, Spanish, etc. You'll also have an app that easily does video, audio, and screen reording to monitor your progress.

A TYPICAL CLASS
25 or 50 mins
▸ Warm up & review (10 mins)
▸ Pronunciation exercises (20 mins)
▸ Long-form accent practice (20 mins)
▸ Summary & closing (5 mins)

FOR THIS CLASS YOU SHOULD
▸ be ready for some complex material 
▸ practice regularly (there’s no way to improve without practice)
▸ be able to hold a conversation (this class is NOT for beginners)
▸ have a decent microphone and webcam (I need to hear you speak and see how you move your lips to guide your pronunciation)

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
▸ How long until I sound native?
This depends on you and your goals. I can tell you that students usually learn to correctly produce the sound or feature within one class, but then take a few weeks of self practice for it to feel natural
▸ How many classes should I take per week? 
One hour once a week is most popular. Sometimes students take it twice
▸ I speak ____ so English is harder for me, will you be able to help me?
I have helped numerous people from all different types of languages and I have created specific lesson plans tailored to your native languages. Feel free to message me and I can send you the Accent Reduction course syllabus for your linguistic background

ARE YOU READY?
Are you willing to do what it takes to improve your accent and sound like a native English speaker? If so, I’ll see you in class! :)

MORE CLASS TIMES AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST! Message me!

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed to meet the specific needs and goals of the student. It will provide a tailored approach to improving the student's grammar skills and help them achieve their language learning objectives.

Objective:

The objective of this customized grammar lesson is to provide the student with help in the areas of grammar that they need to improve their English-speaking skills. The lesson will be completely focused on the student's specific need(s).

Materials:

The materials used in this lesson are from my own specialized curriculum made by myself and will be tailored to the student's level and learning goals. This will include worksheets, some handouts, and other language materials such as articles, videos, and audio recordings. 

Lesson Outline:

1.	Topic Explanation: I will provide a clear and concise explanation of the specific area of grammar that the student requested. I will use real-life examples and provide relevant context to ensure that the student grasps the concepts fully.
2.	Practice: I will provide the student with a range of exercises to practice applying the grammar rules and structures. These may include fill-in-the-blank exercises, sentence construction exercises, and role-playing activities.
3.	Feedback and Correction: I will provide the student with feedback on their performance and correct any errors that they make. I will also provide guidance on how to improve and offer additional practice opportunities as needed.


At the end of the lesson, the teacher and the student will review the progress made, discuss any areas that need further attention, and set goals for future lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Free Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
The Free Conversation lesson is an informal and relaxed lesson designed to help you practice your English conversational skills. This program is ideal for those who want to improve their confidence in speaking English and practice using the language in a natural setting.

Objectives:

The objectives of this lesson are to provide you with opportunities to practice your conversational skills, increase your fluency, gain confidence in speaking, and improve your listening skills.

Program Outline:

The lesson is informal and flexible, and there is no specific outline or structure. The program allows for free-flowing conversation and can cover a range of topics and themes picked specifically by the student. The program's approach is student-led, and the teacher will facilitate the conversation based on the student's interests and preferences.
Each session of the Free Conversation Program allows for the student to have an opportunity to speak while also receiving feedback and correction from the teacher. The program's informal and relaxed nature allows for the student to feel comfortable and confident while speaking.

By participating in this lesson, you will have opportunities to practice your conversational skills, gain confidence in speaking, and improve your listening skills. The program is designed to be flexible and adaptable, allowing for a range of topics and themes to be explored during the conversation while making the student feel relaxed, comfortable, and confident while speaking.
